comment: Every NotSupported case in a committed baseline must match one entry (fnmatch pattern; the first match counts). scripts/docs/generate.py fails otherwise. 'kind' is 'extension' (a group for an extension or optional capability WineMetalGL does not offer), 'version' (the case needs a newer GL version than the context) or 'test-design' (the CTS reports NotSupported for this combination on every implementation; the reason cites the test code).

The case runs only on OpenGL 4.1 or newer contexts.

The case pairs a texture target with an access routine or format that the test marks invalid (gl3cTextureSwizzleTests.cpp isTargetSuppByAccess/isTargetSuppByFormat, or a format whose m_minimum_gl_context is above 3.3), so it reports NotSupported on every implementation.
Below a GL 3.3 context the case needs GL_ARB_sample_shading (glcFragCoordConventionsTests.cpp), which is not advertised; KHR-GL33 runs it.

KHR-GL31 creates a forward-compatible 3.1 context, and glu::contextSupports (gluRenderContext.cpp) matches a forward-compatible context only against its exact version, so the case's check for a GL 3.0 context fails (glcClipDistance.cpp); KHR-GL30, KHR-GL32 and KHR-GL33 run it.

KHR-GL31 creates a forward-compatible 3.1 context, and glu::contextSupports (gluRenderContext.cpp) matches a forward-compatible context only against its exact version, so the case's check for a GL 3.0 context fails (glcTextureLodBiasTests.cpp); KHR-GL30, KHR-GL32 and KHR-GL33 run it.
GL_ARB_sparse_texture2 is not advertised.

The sparseTexture*ARB lookups need GL_ARB_sparse_texture2, which is not advertised.
GL_ARB_post_depth_coverage is not advertised: Metal has no post-depth-test sample coverage input.
The case needs GL_MAX_IMAGE_SAMPLES above 0. WineMetalGL reports 0, the GL minimum: Metal shaders cannot write multisample textures.
The case needs 8 samples; GL_MAX_SAMPLES is 4, the most every color and depth format takes on the Metal device.

The case needs GL_MAX_VERTEX_OUTPUT_COMPONENTS to cover GL_MAX_TESS_CONTROL_INPUT_COMPONENTS (esextcTessellationShaderTessellation.cpp, TessellationShaderTessellationMaxInOut::initTest). WineMetalGL reports the GL minimums, 64 and 128.
The cases run only in OpenGL ES contexts and report NotSupported on every desktop context (esextcTextureCubeMapArrayGenerateMipMap.cpp).
The cases need HDR ASTC (GL_KHR_texture_compression_astc_hdr), which OpenGL ES contexts do not advertise (LDR ASTC only).
GL_OES_stencil1 and GL_OES_stencil4 are not advertised.

OpenGL ES copies only into formats whose component sizes match the source's; the test reports NotSupported for a non-renderable format with other sizes on every implementation (glcInternalformatTests.cpp, CopyTexImageCase).
Item 8 fetches cull distances only for points; the test reports NotSupported for lines and triangles on every implementation (glcCullDistance.cpp, CullDistance::FunctionalTest::iterate).
KHR-GLES3 creates OpenGL ES 3.0 contexts; stencil texturing needs OpenGL ES 3.1.
Without `#extension GL_EXT_shader_integer_mix` the case needs GLSL ES 3.10; KHR-GLES3 compiles it as GLSL ES 3.00 (glcShaderIntegerMixTests.cpp, ShaderIntegerMixPrototypesCase).
dEQP-GLES2 combines several color attachments only with GL_NV_fbo_color_attachments (es2fFboCompletenessTests.cpp), which is not advertised.
The cases render to the default framebuffer and need it multisampled; configuration 1 (`rgba8888d24s8ms0`) has no samples, so they report NotSupported on every implementation.
The cases need a multisampled default framebuffer; configuration 1 (`rgba8888d24s8ms0`) has none, so they report NotSupported on every implementation.
OpenGL ES contexts support line widths up to 1 (ALIASED_LINE_WIDTH_RANGE); wider lines are optional.
OpenGL ES contexts support line widths up to 1 (ALIASED_LINE_WIDTH_RANGE); wider lines are optional.

Dynamic indexing of gl_FragData is optional in GLSL ES 1.00 (and the 3.00 cases use it through ES 1.00 shaders); the test reports NotSupported unless the implementation's own capability flag is set (glsShaderLibraryCase.cpp).
GL_EXT_multisampled_render_to_texture is not advertised.
The cases capture more components than MAX_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_INTERLEAVED_COMPONENTS / SEPARATE_COMPONENTS (the OpenGL ES minimums) allow.

Separate depth and stencil attachments are FRAMEBUFFER_UNSUPPORTED (Metal stores depth and stencil together); OpenGL ES allows reporting them unsupported.
GL_OVR_multiview is not advertised.
The RGB565 configuration has no depth buffer, so the case reports NotSupported on every implementation.
The RGB565 configuration has no stencil buffer, so the case reports NotSupported on every implementation.
In the multisample configuration the default framebuffer is multisampled and OpenGL ES cannot blit into it, so the cases report NotSupported on every implementation (glsScissorTests.cpp).
The cases need 8 samples; GL_MAX_SAMPLES and the integer and float formats' sample counts are 4, the most Apple GPUs render with.
The cases need more atomic counters per stage than GL_MAX_*_ATOMIC_COUNTERS allows; the test reports NotSupported below its array size.
GL_EXT_shader_group_vote is not advertised in OpenGL ES contexts.
The case needs GL_MAX_VERTEX_OUTPUT_COMPONENTS to cover GL_MAX_TESS_CONTROL_INPUT_COMPONENTS (esextcTessellationShaderTessellation.cpp); WineMetalGL reports the OpenGL ES minimums.
OpenGL ES requires a tessellation control shader with an evaluation shader; the case runs only where an evaluation shader may be used alone (esextcTessellationShaderTessellation.cpp).
OpenGL ES has no shader subroutines; the case runs only on desktop GL (glcViewportArrayTests.cpp).
